segments.name: Compute Services and Treasury Management
segments.description: Provides customers access to distributed GPU compute capacity for AI and high-performance computing workloads via the Aethir network, and manages the ATH treasury strategy.
segments.evidence: Collectively, we refer to this new operating business as our Compute Services and Treasury Management segment, which is the priority of the Company and Management's focus.

segments.name: Drug Discovery Services
segments.evidence: (2) the Drug Discovery Services segment, which provides services that include the application of AI using its proprietary biobank of 150,000+ tumor samples, as well as creation of proprietary 3D culture models used in drug development.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for access to GPU compute capacity sourced through the Aethir network, and the Company earns staking yield and potential appreciation on its ATH treasury holdings.
revenueModel.evidence: Axe Compute seeks to provide customers with access to graphics processing unit ("GPU") compute capacity for artificial intelligence and other high-performance computing workloads, sourced primarily through infrastructure made available by the Aethir network.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company sold the assets of its Skyline Medical subsidiary, previously the Eagan operating segment, to DeRoyal Industries.
changes.evidence: On March 20, 2025, the Company completed the sale of assets related to its wholly owned subsidiary, Skyline Medical Inc., to DeRoyal Industries, Inc., a global manufacturer and supplier of medical products.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company added the Compute Services and Treasury Management segment and renamed itself from Predictive Oncology Inc. to Axe Compute Inc.
changes.evidence: In late 2025, we expanded our business strategy to include a compute business under the Axe Compute brand, and renamed the Company Axe Compute Inc., effective December 11, 2025.
